t.zh: 量词里面还可以有量词。每个量词有自己的变量，管到它后面的整段：∀x. … ∃y. … 里，x 和 y 各指各的。量词管着的变量是<wiki-ref to="bound"></wiki-ref>；没有量词管着的是<wiki-ref to="free"></wiki-ref>，句子就说不清在讲谁。
t.en: A quantifier may hold another. Each has its own variable and reaches over everything after it: in ∀x. … ∃y. …, x and y each stand for their own thing. A variable some quantifier covers is a <wiki-ref to="bound"></wiki-ref>; one no quantifier covers is a <wiki-ref to="free"></wiki-ref>, and then the sentence does not say whom it means.

brief.zh: 用下面的元件，把这句话拼成公式。
brief.en: Build this sentence as a formula from the parts below.

say.zh: 每样东西都喜欢某样东西。

hint.zh: 外面是对所有 x，里面是有一个 y：x 喜欢的那样东西，另用一个变量。
hint.en: Outside, every x; inside, some y: the thing x likes takes another variable.

brief.zh: 用下面的元件，把这句话拼成公式。
brief.en: Build this sentence as a formula from the parts below.

hint.zh: 对所有 x，若 x 是人，则有一个 y 是 x 的父母。
hint.en: For every x, if x is human, then some y is a parent of x.

say.zh: 每样东西都喜欢某样东西。

brief.zh: 上一段你把这句话拼成了公式；这是别人拼的。造一个世界，让两份译文真假不同。
brief.en: You built this sentence as a formula; this is someone else’s. Build a world where the two differ in truth.

hint.zh: 把它想成一个游戏：∀ 由对手挑，∃ 由你挑。第一句是对手先挑 x，你再挑 y；第二句是你先挑 y，对手再挑 x。
hint.en: Think of it as a game: the opponent picks for ∀, you pick for ∃. In the first, the opponent picks x first, then you pick y; in the second you pick y first, then the opponent picks x.

hint.zh: 每样东西各喜欢自己就行。
